inputs.description: Appends the alert to the alert log — the equivalent of outputs/alert_log.csv in this repo.

Body.Content: Data quality check @{items('For_each_failed_check')?['check_id']} (@{items('For_each_failed_check')?['dimension']}) on @{items('For_each_failed_check')?['table']}.@{items('For_each_failed_check')?['field']} found @{items('For_each_failed_check')?['violations']} violations (@{items('For_each_failed_check')?['violation_rate']} of rows checked). See the Power BI data quality scorecard for details.

inputs.description: Emails the data owner named on the scorecard row. In this repo the same payload is produced by src/alerting.py with simulated dispatch.
Reads one row per check (DQ01–DQ25) with status, violations, severity, data_owner and owner_email — the same shape as outputs/scorecard.csv.

metadata.description: SPECIFICATION ONLY — not a live flow. Reads the data quality scorecard after each run and emails the data owner of every failed check. The Python implementation of this exact logic, with simulated dispatch, is src/alerting.py.
metadata.name: Data Quality Owner Alert
metadata.note: No email is sent by this repository. To go live, import this definition into Power Automate, connect the Outlook and SharePoint connectors, and point the scorecard source at the real pipeline output.

Recurrence.description: Runs daily after the scheduled data quality check run completes.
